targets.query: SELECT (mean("used") - mean("shared"))  / 1073741824 FROM "mem" WHERE ("host"::tag = 'sn11.bi.privat') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT (mean("total") - ((mean("used") + mean("buffered"))))  / 1073741824 FROM "mem" WHERE ("host"::tag = 'sn11.bi.privat') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage_iowait") FROM "cpu" WHERE ("host" = 'sn11.bi.privat') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage_irq") FROM "cpu" WHERE ("host" = 'sn11.bi.privat') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage_nice") FROM "cpu" WHERE ("host" = 'sn11.bi.privat') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT 100 - (mean("usage_idle") + mean("usage_nice") + mean("usage_irq") + mean("usage_iowait")) FROM "cpu" WHERE ("host" = 'sn11.bi.privat') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage_idle") FROM "cpu" WHERE ("host" = 'sn11.bi.privat') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("avg_tup_dead")  / 1000 FROM "postgresql" WHERE ("server"::tag = 'pg-sn11' AND "db"::tag = 'galaxy') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("avg_tup_live") / mean("avg_tup_dead") FROM "postgresql" WHERE ("server"::tag = 'pg-sn11' AND "db"::tag = 'galaxy') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
